For partners

Partner with the people shaping the conversation

We build focused international forums around important ideas and difficult industry problems. Our partnerships create credible participation and real access, not simply logo exposure.

Who we partner with

Different partners create different kinds of value

Technology & Solution Partners

Companies whose products or expertise are directly relevant to the event problem.

Knowledge Partners

Research organisations, universities, associations, authors and expert communities.

Community Partners

Professional groups and networks that strengthen the audience.

Media & Content Partners

Publishers, newsletters and podcasts that extend the conversation.

Why partner

Reach a curated audience, not a generic crowd

  • Engage professionals already working on the problem you solve
  • Position expertise through clearly labelled sessions or workshops
  • Meet decision-makers, architects, founders and industry leaders
  • Generate high-intent conversations before, during and after
  • Extend visibility through content, speaker activity and comms
  • Build relationships with experts and potential customers
